title: How to Defend Against AI-Designed Viruses
script:
War on the Rocks analyzed how to defend against AI-designed viruses.
Advanced algorithms could lower the barrier for creating pathogens.
Experts argue we must secure DNA supply chains.
Will genetic screening stop malicious actors?
